title: Record a bug fix as red then green, and label live proof with its feature and evidence
action: Adopt the L6 proof practices (per D2 and D4). Edit expertise/tests.md, the SOURCE that onboarding copies into .bee/expertise/ — never edit .bee/expertise/ by hand; the regen in pca-10 copies it. Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). expertise/tests.md § 'Red before green': a bug-fix cap carries two proof lines — `<cmd> — red: <observed failure> — reproduces <bug>` then `<cmd> — green — same test after fix`; when no test can reach the bug, record the reason before the fix and pick the closest check that can run, whose output is the red line; this applies to any bug fix whose failure can be run, and a one-line fix with a known cause still records both lines. skills/bee-verifying/SKILL.md § 5 (the fast-drive proof): the proof line becomes `bash .bee/verify/verify-app/control-<app> drive --fast <feature> — green:live <feature-id>@<entry-point> — <evidence path>`; a mutation proof adds a second read-only view; an entry point that was not driven is named as skipped, never covered by another. Keep every heading.

truths: A bug-fix cap records a red line and a green line
A live proof names its feature, entry point and evidence path
